A.notes: All fields with required+email checks, checkbox, explicit 'Sign in' button and link, neatly wrapped in a Card.

A.notes: Email check, required + min-8 on both passwords, and the terms checkbox correctly checked with eq(agree, true).

B.notes: Good checks overall, but 'required' on a boolean checkbox may accept false, so it may not actually enforce agreeing to the terms.

A.notes: Covers everything: the Page title is the header, there is a Mark all as read button, and five Rows each have an Avatar, message, a relative time made by formatRelativeTime and a New badge on the first two, though the visible cond(...) wrapper adds nothing over binding $unread directly.
